skill.body:

generated_query:
I'm building a content management dashboard for articles. I need a form for creating a new article that includes:
- A title input with error handling
- A rich text body textarea
- A multi-chip input for tags (using accent color for the chip container)
- A featured image upload card (styled with a secondary border-top)
- A separate card for the article status with a published/unpublished toggle

I want the entire main form to be wrapped in a fancy card with a primary border-top and hover shadow effect. All inputs should have the Emerald theme focus states (e.g., focus:input-primary for text inputs, focus:select-primary for select, focus:textarea-info for the body textarea). Also, the tag container should use the multi-chip input container pattern. Could you help me write the React component code for this, using Tailwind CSS with DaisyUI and the Emerald theme?
